title: Android LinearLayout: editable text baselines
purpose: Check that entered text in EditText and autocomplete fields aligns by baseline with larger text in horizontal XML layouts.
changes: Baseline-aware layouts now use the entered-text baseline for EditText, AutoCompleteTextView and MultiAutoCompleteTextView.
steps: Find Editable and text baselines below the Right-to-left layout switch. Each row pairs an editable field containing text with larger text.
Compare the bottom of the entered letters with Large: their text baselines should line up in all three rows.
Tap a field and edit its text; the alignment should remain stable. Turn on Right-to-left layout and check that columns reverse while baselines remain aligned.
Choose OK if the rows work as described, or Reject with the row, problem and your device.
expected: Entered text in each field shares a baseline with the larger text in LTR and RTL while the field remains editable.
limits: This checks Bhoo's current entered-text layout and font metrics. Empty hint presentation, exact Android theme and font metrics, and device visual parity remain unverified.

references.scope: Text baseline contract inherited by editable text controls.

validation: Rust layout test checks entered-text baselines for all three field types against larger text in LTR and RTL.
